next_gate.root_cause: Observer enables source sites only after selected_socket_source; selected context can already be blocked inside poll. Strict requirement for captured entry is therefore unsatisfied; this does not identify target defect.
next_gate.required_scratch_guard: At callback entry, if observation_failed or completion_observed, return True before target reads or state changes. AutoContinue False cannot prevent all callbacks already queued in one stop batch.
next_gate.required_observation_design: Represent preobserver in-flight poll as explicit partial epoch. At selected-source mapping, inspect stopped thread stack/frames read-only for exact pinned poll frame/current instruction; prove context, poll array/count, kevent event buffer/capacity from byte-verified live register/frame lifetimes. If unavailable stop as unproven. A return may be recorded as a return-only partial epoch with explicit missing entry; do not fabricate call entry, timeout or arguments.
next_gate.acceptance: Inherited control must establish actual selected-source/context readiness and complete source dispatch matched to existing R before normal. Require exact entry/return for a newly observed poll, or separately reviewed supported live in-flight frame capture with explicit preobserver boundary. No relaxed readiness predicates and no inference from absence.
